feature: Strategy focus, PR 3: the strategy block on Analysis (ring, legend with the focus pick, focus line)
note: Needs ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED and STRATEGY_FOCUS_ENABLED 'true' (and TUNING_ENABLED for the tools below it), on a scratch branch off local-dev migrated past 0172, as the audit account. The block draws only over a reading, so each deck must have been analyzed. SF_NOFOCUS_DECK: an analyzed deck with no focus (HD - Brago). SF_FOCUS_DECK: an analyzed deck with a focus set in its top five (HD - Elves, strategy_focus 'typal:Elf'). SF_PENDING_DECK: an analyzed, committed deck with a focus and cards toward it added since the commit (HD Tune - Blood Rites). The empty states (none, tooSmall) and a focus outside the top five are held by strategy-block.test.tsx: a deck under 30 nonland cannot hold a reading.

rows.label: /decks/[id] Analysis: the ring with an empty dashed centre, the legend's radios empty, No focus yet
